_sheet: Modifier channels. One row = one number on a climber that cards can change. Units: 100 spec units = one full stamina bar = 1.0 in PEAK (statuses use the same scale). 'mul' channels multiply (1 = unchanged, cards stack multiplicatively); 'add' channels add (0 = unchanged). Every channel in cards.json must be an id here. Generated/ClimbStats.cs gets the Channel enum and this table.

_columns.label: readable name
_columns.better: lower | higher: which direction helps the climber (preflight: Mythics and drawback-free cards only move channels this way)
_columns.more: in-game wording when the value goes up (mul above 1, add above 0); {0} is the amount ("30%", "25", "0.3 seconds")
_columns.less: in-game wording when the value goes down
_columns.never: in-game wording when a mul reaches 0 (empty: use "less" with 100%)
_columns.capGroup: none | staminaCost (normal cards combined cannot go below 1 - StaminaCostCap) | maxStamina (normal cards combined cannot pull max stamina below the floor)
_columns.appliesVia: where the mod applies it in the game
_columns.designNote: notes on units or edge cases

rows.label: Climbing stamina cost

rows.label: Cold decay
